data.title: Golf Grand
data.about:
Imagine waking up each morning to the stunning vistas of the Dubai Hills Golf Course and the lush greenery of Dubai Hills Estate. At Golf Grand by Emaar, you can experience modern urban luxury amidst the tranquility of nature. 

With contemporary architecture and a commitment to sustainability, your new home at Golf Grand is situated along the Club Villas Park, providing you with a unique living experience that is unparalleled in the city. Here, you can relax and enjoy the best things in life, from morning walks along the winding paths to afternoon picnics in the park.

Select from 1 to 3 bedroom apartments at Golf Grand by Emaar and come home to Dubai Hills Estate, where luxury meets nature. Don’t miss out on this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to experience the ultimate in modern urban living.

location_tile.title: Come Home to Dubai Hills Estate
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Experience modern luxury living in Dubai Hills Estate with easy access to Al Khail Road, Downtown Dubai, and other centers. Proximity to Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro lines offers quick access to airports and other emirates in the near future.

  • 15 Mins from Downtown Dubai
  • 15 Mins from Dubai Marina
  • 20 Mins from Dubai International Airpor
  • 25 Mins from District 2020
